description: Department of Local Government - North Western Province - Notify that the meeting for the purpose of electing the Mayor for the Kurunegala Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the schedule for a mayoral election for the Kurunegala Municipal Council, which falls under electoral processes as defined for Type 7 (Elections Gazettes). The content is published under the Local Government Elections Ordinance and its amendments, specifically notifying the date, time, and location for the election meeting.
